title: Understanding Model Variance
text: When you add a new feature to a model, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, think about how it might affect the model's flexibility. More flexibility can lead to changes in variance.

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: Adding a feature that is a transformation of an existing feature can increase the model's ability to fit the training data. Consider how this might impact the model's variance.
